text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Oaks has
arrived. Air
Groove's mother won this
race in the past, and
Эйр Грув strives
to follow in her footsteps.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув wonders how her mother felt
when she
ran here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She steps onto the track with
heightened focus,
determined to chase
her ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
